title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in The Events Calendar plugin by Liquid Web / StellarWP, allowing improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This vulnerability affects versions up to and including 6.18.3. The flaw could allow an attacker to inject code that is executed in the context of the affected web page. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating a medium severity level.
